scope: Use only the verified FLC targets and distinct siblings of the formal error study. Fixed disjoint background apertures avoid GD153. Use same PAM, DQ-zero support, radii and local-median sky. For each aperture compare observed summed residual to a diagonal Gaussian null with the measured ERR per retained pixel and a flat expectation. Report all supported patches plus a fixed limit on largest absolute normalized residual in the aperture or annulus, retaining rejections. The resulting dispersion is an empirical background diagnostic, not a calibration of signal-dependent or missing-pixel covariance.
